---
title: "08 - NicheNet"
subtitle: "The ligands behind each comparison's changes"
---

```{r}
source("_helpers.R")
source("_figures.R")
na_f <- find_tab("^nichenet_ligand_activities\\.csv$")
```

For each comparison and receiver cell type, NicheNet ranks the ligands of the neighbouring senders by how well their known targets predict the receiver's changed genes.

```{r}
page_top(
  stages = "cci",
  Input = "The spatial object, the comparisons from <code>compare_by</code> and the NicheNet model in <code>nichenet_model_dir</code>.",
  Method = "NicheNet for each receiver in <code>nichenet_receivers</code>, the top <code>nichenet_top_ligands</code> ligands by corrected AUPR, with <code>nichenet_n_targets</code> targets each.",
  Output = "The tables in <code>tables/08_cci/nichenet</code>."
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(render_tree(list(
  "Runs" = function() tab("^nichenet_summary\\.csv$", note = "Each comparison and receiver, and whether NicheNet ran on it."),
  "Ligand activity" = function() {
    na <- read_files(na_f)
    if (is.null(na) || !all(c("test_ligand", "aupr_corrected", "receiver", "comparison") %in% names(na))) {
      return(missing_note("NicheNet has not run."))
    }
    n_lig <- min(25L, length(unique(na$test_ligand)))
    n_col <- length(unique(paste(na$comparison, na$receiver)))
    fig <- rfig("nichenet_activity", c(na_f, RUN$label_colours), function() {
      top <- na[, .(best = max(aupr_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)), by = test_ligand][order(-best)][seq_len(n_lig), test_ligand]
      d <- na[test_ligand %in% top]
      d[, `:=`(test_ligand = factor(test_ligand, rev(top)), receiver = display_name(receiver, STYLE))]
      heat_plot(d, "receiver", "test_ligand", "aupr_corrected", name = "Corrected\nAUPR") + facet_wrap(~comparison, scales = "free_x")
    }, 3 + 0.5 * n_col, 1.8 + 0.2 * n_lig)
    tagList(
      rgallery(list(`Ligand activity per receiver, the 25 most active ligands` = fig), big = TRUE),
      tab("^nichenet_ligand_activities\\.csv$", order = "-aupr_corrected"),
      csv_links(find_tab("^nichenet_ligand_(receptor_links|target_links|senders)\\.csv$"))
    )
  },
  ".pipeline" = function() pipeline_figures(figs("08_cci/nichenet", "\\.png$", FALSE)),
  "Parameters" = function() {
    params_table(c("nichenet_receivers", "nichenet_top_ligands", "nichenet_n_targets", "compare_by", "compare_baseline", "compare_within"), "cci")
  }
)))
```
